""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Extracting actual descriptions from dd/p elements following function signatures will increase completeness # MECHANISM-1: Most API docs place descriptions in dd or p tags adjacent to dt/code elements, capturing these improves documentation quality # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.40 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.325) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Deduplicating functions by name before returning will improve accuracy by reducing false positives # MECHANISM-2: Multiple search strategies find the same function, causing duplicate entries that lower accuracy scores # EXPECT-2: accuracy > 0.78 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.7222222222222222) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_names = set() # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (most structured) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Look for description in next dd sibling desc = "No description found" next_dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") if next_dd: desc_text = next_dd.get_text(strip=True) if desc_text: desc = desc_text[:200] # Limit length functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), }) # 2. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Look for description in nearby p or div desc = "No description found" parent = block.parent if parent: next_p = parent.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: desc = next_p.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 3. Look for function signatures in headers for tag in ["h3", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(tag) for block in headers: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name and name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) # Get description from next paragraph desc = "No description found" next_p = block.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: desc = next_p.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) return functions[:20] def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Extract parameter information from a function signature.""" params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Split by comma, but handle nested parentheses/brackets param_parts = [p.strip() for p in param_string.split(",") if p.strip()] for part in param_parts: if not part or part in ["...", "*", "**"]: continue # Extract name, type, and default param_name = part.split(":")[0].split("=")[0].strip() param_type = "unknown" param_default = None # Try to extract type annotation if ":" in part: type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip() if type_part: param_type = type_part # Try to extract default value if "=" in part: default_part = part.split("=")[-1].strip() if default_part: param_default = default_part params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": param_default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
